_help: base_url: address of the API server without /api; empty means no server, data stored on the device. tiles_url: full address of the PMTiles archive of Krakow, read in byte ranges; empty or unreachable means the sample base map bundled in the app. 10.0.2.2 is the computer that runs the emulator; a real phone needs the LAN address of the computer (make api-device) or the public address of the demo server. Set with tools/api_target.py.
